title: 第4章 战斗的余温第5章 奖励到账
content_zh:
一连打出数发【火焰箭】，柯林有种脑子转不动的感觉，稍不注意注意力就会迅速溃散进入发呆状态。
具体来说，就好像一连做了三套数学试卷似的。
但事已至此，除了继续施法念咒外根本没活路。
咔嚓。
就柯林念叨着下一个戏法的咒语时，树枝被踩断的咔嚓声传到耳边。
柯林想都没想，握紧手中的武器直接向声音来源挥去，剑刃嘎吱一声砍在一个怪物身上。
干枯的枝条压根扛不住剑刃，这下直接砍下那怪物的一条手臂。
回头一看，几个怪物绕到马车后方摸了过来。
动作不停，柯林将武器挥过一圈。
周围几个同时扑上来的怪物被剑刃逼退，它们顿时发现眼前这个看似弱小的人类好像不是什么好惹的货色。
脖颈间的血管跳动不断，血液被泵动的感觉清晰可辨。
柯林大口喘着粗气，死死盯着周围的敌人。
除了干掉眼前这些想要自己性命的怪物之外，他的脑子里没有任何想法。
忽然间。
他又感觉肩膀猛地被人一扯，视野立刻向后飞去。
呼啦！
耳边传来一阵风声，扯住柯林往后拖的凯斯跳上马车，一斧直接将再次扑上来的几只怪物打飞，几个冒险者紧随其后将怪物们从马车周围逼退。
这些恶心的小怪物一下子缩到周围，再次和眼前的凡人们对峙。
就这样僵持了十几秒之后。
没被火焰缠上的怪物猛然回头，他们像松鼠似的一下就窜到没影了，只丢下几个被火焰箭点燃的怪物和一阵灌木耸动的簌簌声。

“它们可能有援军，赶紧走了！”车夫大声喊道。
这时候，冒险者们没去看车队的领头人，反而齐刷刷看向在场所有人中装备最简陋也最年轻的那位。
我什么时候成领头的了？
感受到视线聚集在自己身上的柯林微微一愣。
他赶紧冲向系着缰绳的树干并喊道：“听他的吧，咱们快走！”
这下，一行人才快速行动起来。
拾掇起怪物的尸体后，便立刻赶着马车顺着道路前进。
几乎所有人手里都捏着火把，时刻准备应对追上来的怪物，懂得包扎伤口的冒险者则照顾着受伤的倒霉蛋。
车队内一片沉默，在这种气氛下没人乐意说话。
淡淡的血腥味让鼻腔里变得黏腻。
坐在马车上的柯林麻木地看着漆黑一片的道路。
他死死盯着周围的灌木，甚至连面板都不敢看上一眼。
content_en:
After firing several [Fire Arrows] in succession, Colin felt like his brain couldn't move, and if he didn't pay attention, he would quickly collapse into a daze.
Specifically, it was like taking three sets of math papers in a row.
But the matter has come to this, and there is no way to survive except to continue casting spells and chanting spells.
Click.
As Colin was chanting the incantation for the next trick, the click of branches being broken reached his ears.
Without thinking, Colin clenched the weapon in his hand and swung it directly towards the source of the sound. The blade struck a monster with a crunching sound.
The dry branches couldn't bear the blade at all, and this time he cut off one of the monster's arms.
Looking back, several monsters came around to the back of the carriage and touched it.
Without stopping, Colin swung the weapon in a circle.
Several surrounding monsters that rushed forward at the same time were forced back by the sword. They suddenly realized that the seemingly weak human in front of them was not something to be trifled with.
The blood vessels in the neck are beating continuously, and the feeling of blood being pumped is clearly discernible.
Colin gasped for air and stared at the enemies around him.
Apart from killing the monsters in front of him who wanted his life, he had no other thoughts in his mind.
suddenly.
He felt a sudden tug on his shoulder again, and his vision immediately flew back.
Hooray!
There was a gust of wind in his ears. Keith, who was dragging Colin backwards, jumped onto the carriage and directly knocked away several monsters that rushed towards him again with an axe. Several adventurers followed closely and forced the monsters back from around the carriage.
These disgusting little monsters suddenly shrank around and faced off against the mortals in front of them again.
After a stalemate like this for more than ten seconds.
The monsters that were not caught in the flames suddenly turned around and disappeared like squirrels, leaving only a few monsters ignited by the flame arrows and a rustling sound of bushes.
"They may have reinforcements, leave quickly!" the coachman shouted.
At this time, the adventurers did not look at the leader of the convoy. Instead, they all looked at the person with the simplest equipment and the youngest among all the people present.
When did I become the leader?
Colin was slightly startled when he felt the eyes focused on him.
He rushed to the tree trunk where the reins were tied and shouted: "Listen to him, let's go!"
Now, the group of people took action quickly.
After picking up the monster's body, they immediately drove the carriage along the road.
Almost everyone held torches in their hands, always ready to deal with the monsters that caught up. Adventurers who knew how to bandage wounds took care of the injured unfortunates.
There was silence in the convoy, and no one was willing to speak in this atmosphere.
The faint smell of blood made the nasal cavity sticky.
Colin, who was sitting in the carriage, looked numbly at the dark road.
He stared at the surrounding bushes, not even daring to glance at the panel.
